introHtml: Sublimation printing allows for full-color, all-over designs that won't crack or peel, making it ideal for custom apparel accessories like socks, shoelaces, and headbands. Unlike standard screen printing, sublimation dyes bond with polyester fabrics, producing vibrant, permanent graphics that stretch with the material. Whether you need branded socks for a 5K race or custom headbands for a corporate wellness program, sublimation delivers crisp logos and patterns that last.
